questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
Jeg ville kun til Frankrig (Paris) pga. fransk ophav og familie/venne relationer. 
Paris er en superfed by at studere i, billigere end København, gode transportmuligheder og mulighed for udflugter rundt omkring i Frankrig.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Nemt nok, det største problem var at Dauphine var langsomme til at uploade deres kursuskatalog.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Intet, jeg deltog i velkomstdagene hvor generel information om universitet og regler blev gennemgået. Der var et internationalt kontor fysisk tilstede på campus som var behjælpelige og generelt gjorde de meget ud af at udvekslingsstuderende fik en god oplevelse (i hvert fald rent administrativt / socialt)

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg boede i Cité Universitaire, det er ret billigt (under 5.000kr om måneden) for et værelse i enten det danske hus eller i et af de andre huse. Ligger 10-15 min i tog fra centrum af Paris. Mulighed for socialt samvær med både andre danske og internatonale studerende i Paris.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Citéen er relativt billig, ellers kan det hurtigt komme til at koste omkring 10k for et lille studio.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Den administrative tilmelding var nem nok, men der var meget forvirring omkring kursustilmelding.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Sker ret sent og de opdaterer ikke kursuslisten før selve tilmeldingsdagen (slut november). Det gik heldigvis, men nogle kurser havde ikke engang kursusbeskrivelser. Der var klart flest økonomiske/business  kurser, og ikke ligeså mange rent politologiske kurser og de fleste kurser var BA kurser men som MA studerende kunne få adgang til. Alle kurser er 3 eller 6 ects. Jeg tror udbuddet er forskelligt fra forår til efterår.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Dauphine var generelt gode til at svare hurtigt og fyldestgørende på mails, medmindre de ikke havde svaret så lod de helt være med at svare medmindre man var insisterende og skrev gentagne gange. Det havde været bedre hvis de bare havde skrevet at det kunne de ikke hjælpe med i stedet for at lade en hænge i flere uger/måneder.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik plads på alle mine fag men var også kun afsted med 15ECTS

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det skal nok gå, men vær forberedt på at kursusbeskrivelserne bliver opdateret ret sent og at der godt kan være en del døde links på deres hjemmesider. Lad dig ikke skræmme af at kurserne står som bachelorkurser hvis du selv er kandidatstuderende, bare sørg for at KU forhåndsgodkender dem.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Generelt meget lavt akademisk niveau men relativt svære eksamener taget niveauet i betragtning og sammenlignet med KU (alt er i hånden uden hjælpemidler). Vi læser ikke mange primærtekster og undervisningen foregår mere på samme niveau som i gymnasiet, hvor din samlede karakter ikke blot er eksamen, men også dækker over mundtlige fremlæggelser, lektier, og deltagelse i timerne. 
Brugte færre timer på skole end jeg ville have gjort herhjemme.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde kun holdundervisning, vær forberedt på at det ofte bare er underviseren som taler i 3 timer.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Migrations in Globalisation (6 ECTS)
Understanding Contemporary Issues: A Sociological Outlook (6 ECTS)
Current issues in UK / US politics (3 ECTS)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Alle kurserne var egentlig helt fine. Migrations faget var det der kom tættest på klassisk KU undervisning og havde en del spændende artikler, sociologifaget gennemgår alle de store sociologer og her bliver der læst primærtekster. UK/US faget var indholdsmæssigt tungest men intet primær litteratur.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Paris er generelt billigere en København men man bruger flere penge end man tror. Jeg brugte dog også en del penge på udflugter rundt omkring i Frankrig.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der var flere muligheder fx sport men jeg gjorde ikke brug af det.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Generelt mange muligheder og et mentorprogram samt et franskprogram som jeg heller ikke gjorde brug af.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag rundt i Frankrig! Med navigo easy pass kan man gratis komme rundt i området omkring Paris. Der går TGV toge til mange af de store byer og tager aldrig mere end 3-4 timer.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Jeg var forberedt på Paris og adskiller sig ikke særlig meget fra DK

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Terrasse og restaurantkulturen.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Du behøver ikke kunne fransk! Tværtimod var det svært for mig at finde franske kurser, det hele er meget internationalt og engelsk. Kom i introdagene og deltag i de sociale aktiviteter den første uge, det er mit indtryk at det er her at de fleste finder deres venner for semesteret. Undervisningen varer 3 timer med 15 min pause hver 1,5 time.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At prøve at bo i et andet land

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Ingen

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
